Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that Mr. Narendra Manohardas Thakker (DIN - 00083224) has tendered his resignation from the position of Executive Director of the Company with effect from the close of business hours on 24th November, 2026 due to personal reasons.

A copy of the resignation letter received from Mr. Narendra Manohardas Thakker (DIN - 00083224) is also enclosed herewith.
